stories.title: Block all AI browsers for the foreseeable future: Gartner
stories.summary: Gartner warns that AI‑enabled browser sidebars routinely send sensitive user data—such as active web pages, browsing history, and open tabs—to cloud‑based AI back‑ends, heightening exposure risk unless security settings are explicitly hardened and centrally managed. The firm recommends first evaluating the AI service’s controls to determine acceptable risk, then educating users that any content they view could be transmitted to the AI. Gartner also flags agentic risks like indirect prompt‑injection leading to rogue actions, erroneous reasoning, credential abuse, and phishing navigation.
